comment: Blocks cut from the OSM planet (osmium extract, simple strategy, bbox [west, south, east, north]) before the regions are cut from them with complete_ways. A region goes to the smallest block that contains the bbox of its outline (mapping/poly) widened by margin degrees. Each stream reads the planet once and writes its blocks; keep a stream at no more than 6 blocks (osmium needs up to about 1.8 GB per block for a full planet).
